items.title: Export is offered on pro and replaced by an upgrade prompt on free
items.evidence: The gate moves with the plan. projects@pro has exportButton: true, projects@free has false and an Upgrade to export button. Both cells settled with 5 rendered rows.

shots.caption: Pro: Export CSV boxed red, the five projects boxed blue.

items.title: The risk tooltip explains the column on a real hover
items.evidence: It opens only under a real mouse. The job hovers the info icon and boxes the open tooltip; a synthetic hover leaves it closed.

items.title: No projects found is in the page text but never shown
items.evidence: Not a bug, and not an empty state. The text sits at opacity 0 next to five loaded rows (emptyTextPresent: true, emptyTextVisible: false). Any check that reads page text or the accessibility tree will report an empty list here.

items.title: A project from another account renders an error page instead of a not-found
items.evidence: No verdict, the shot never had evidence. wrong-id.png is a MISS: the identity check wanted Projects and the page said Something went wrong. Needs a real cross-account id to settle.
